english: Only a legendary Super Dimension Fortress idol scares me!
Gin Tama after all! Bring it on!
Made us waste all that time.
What kind of legend is THAT?!
A case involving TV, all right.
Calm down, Toshi! She's an idol!
TV AND the shogunate involved? Some case!
A case? No scandals, thank you!
We've nothing to do with it.
What kind of case... white birch?
No way! I'm not going anywhere!
Someday I'll ride a cool Super Dimension Fortress too!
Okay, everyone! Listen to my song! It's game over!
Hey! Don't spoil the fun. Enjoy yourselves too!
What are you doing, old man?!
Meeting?! This is a damn party!
And those Joi rebels are apparently trading Gin Tama.
Can't turn a blind eye to that!
Any shogunate VIPs in this room?
Sougo. You can cut that old idiot down.
Seems a large organization is behind it.
Wait! This has to be a mistake!
You don't get it. In the adult world, we CALL this a meeting.
Hard at work, as always. So? How big an organization?
Can I cut this drunk down?
More importantly... Something seem odd to you?
Not a single Joi ronin here.
Don't mess with a drag queen!\fNo plans to have fun? Go home!
Where are those Joi rebels?\fTry the other rooms.
Trading Gin Tama? What are you plotting?!
Come on! Get out of here! ...You said it yourself!
Shut up! Out of the way!
...Where'd you see the gorilla named Shigeyoshi?
Memory's getting worse... Who was I again?
My comrade Shigeyoshi fell fighting Amanto.
Wait... Maybe that was Shigeyoshi, not a gorilla...
G3... Right! That's my name! Cool name!
Huh? Did we come to see a movie?
Feel like... We've come a long way...
Hey, wait. Isn't this the wrong way?
Hey. Is this the right way?
The road. Maybe a hospital could cure that sense of direction?
Right. Raid later. Gin Tama first.
Right. Maybe gather Gin Tama before we go in.
If you say so, Hijikata. Let's storm in.
Damn... Guess we have to keep searching on foot...
Hey! Could you stop doing that? Bad for my heart...
Oh! My bike key! Finally fixed, then.
Huh?! Can't go wherever I want? On MY bike?!
Well, it'll be easier than before, at least.
Let's use it to get around.
Sorry... Hearing you say on foot just reminded me...
Gengai gave me this for you.
Only takes you to set places, unfortunately...
Please don't question that part too much.
Young folks wandering around all day... Nice life.
You government lackeys wouldn't know how ordinary folks suffer!
Keep pestering me and I'll tell your boss.
We have problems too!\fLousy pay, the boss always yelling...\fOh! Tell me if you find a good job!
Where are you taking those gloomy faces?
Hungry and need work? Work in a restaurant. Cash AND food!
Not for you! Find your own.
What?! I'm not Hamuko! My name's Kimiko! KIMIKO!
Um... Could you hire us? We're looking for work.
Only dust on you now, Gin. Not pride.
